stage_goals.description: Establish a legal active Pokemon and a safe Bench.
Improve board options and attach Energy efficiently.
Prefer safe prize-taking actions.
Develop Tandemaus and supporting Basics without clogging slots.
Preserve draw resources and build a useful hand.
Keep Maushold ex active with flexible Special Energy.
Develop Maschiff and Doduo without exposing both engines.
Use Dodrio's public damage state while accelerating Energy.
Keep Mabosstiff ex charged for the closing attacks.
Evolve Altaria ex and keep a second line available.
Place both required Energy colors without stranding attackers.
Use healing to preserve the developed multi-attacker board.
Develop Riolu and Scyther evolution lines.
Use acceleration while keeping a safe second attacker.
Convert the prepared Energy board into knockouts.
Bench Chimchar and protect an evolution route.
Bring Infernape online with renewable Fire Energy.
Keep an attacker supplied while converting knockouts.
Bench multiple evolution lines before committing resources.
Maximize evolved Pokemon for Torterra's pressure.
Maintain a full evolved board and take efficient attacks.
Establish Mareep and a Lightning target on the Bench.
Accelerate enough Energy for Pikachu ex.
Preserve an energized attacker for the final prizes.
Bench Natu and evolve a stable Xatu engine.
Turn Psychic Energy in hand into board tempo.

Move Energy to the best public attacker each turn.

Use public damage windows to finish efficient targets.
